definitions.short: Jehoram , the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites
definitions.full: H3088. Yehoram יֹרָם יוֺרָם, יְהוֺרָם, proper name, masculine ( ׳י is exalted ; compare מַלְכִּירָם ; further, Phoenician רמבעל בעלרם, ; Sabean אלרם DHM ZMG 1876, 686 ) — 1 ׳יְהוֺ ( ᵐ5 Ἰωραμ ) king of Judah, son of Jehoshaphat 1Kin 22:51 ; 2Kin 1:17 ; 8:16 , 25 , 29 ; 12:19 ; 2Chr 21:1 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 9 , 16 ; 22:1 , 6 , 11 ; = ׳יוֺ 2Kin 8:21 , 23 , 24 ; 11:2 ; 1Chr 3:11 . 2 ׳יְהוֺ ( ᵐ5 Ἰωραμ ) king of Israel son of Ahab 2Kin 1:17 ; 3:1 , 6 ; 9:15 , 17 , 21 (twice in verse); 9:22-23 , 2Chr 22:5-6 , 7 ; = ׳יוֺ 2Kin 8:16 , 25 , 28 (twice in verse); 8:29 (twice in verse); 9:14 (twice in verse); 9:16 (twice in verse); 9:29 ; 2Chr 22:5 , 7 . 3 ׳יְהוֺ priest in time of Jehoshaphat 2Chr 17:8 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωραμ , Ἰωραν ). 4 ׳יוֺ son of Tou, king of Hamath 2Sam 8:10 ( ᵐ5 Ἰεδδουραν ) probably error for הֲדוֺרָם || 1Chr 18:10 . 5 יֹרָם a Levite 1Chr 26:25 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωραμ ).
